sourceText:
Halibut Tempura
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 11:59pm

Ingredients




2/3 cup Flour
2/3 cup Cornstarch
1/2 teaspoon Salt
1/8 teaspoon White pepper
1 Egg
Vegetable oil
1 cup Ice water
2 pounds Fish fillets, cut in 1*1*½
Cubes
Soy sauce (optional)
Lemon slices (optional)

Preparation

1 Combine flour, cornstarch, salt & pepper. Beat together egg, 1/4 cup oil & ice water; add egg mixture all at once to dry ingredients, beating with mixer. (Do not overmix. Batter will be lumpy.) Set bowl of batter inside larger bowl filled with ice water. Dip fish into batter; deep fry in oil heated to 375 for 3 minutes, or until golden brown. Drain well on paper towels; serve immediately. Serve with soy sauce & lemon slices.
